19:1.text: [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings]

19:2.text: a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His slave Zakariyyâ

19:3.text: When he called out his Lord

19:4.text: He said: "My Lord! Indeed my bones have grown feeble, and grey hair has spread on my head, And I have never been unblest in my invocation to You, O my Lord!

19:5.text: "And verily I fear my relatives after me, and my wife is barren. So give me from Yourself an heir.

19:6.text: (inheritance of the religious knowledge and Prophethood, not of wealth.)
. And make him, my Lord, one with whom You are Well-Pleased!"

19:7.text: ! Verily, We give you the glad tidings of a son, whose name will be Yahyâ
. We have given that name to none before

19:8.text: He said: "My Lord! How can I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I have reached the extreme old age."

19:9.text: . Your Lord says: It is easy for Me. Certainly I have created you before, when you had been nothing!"

19:10.text: said: "My Lord! Appoint for me a sign." He said: "Your sign is that you shall not speak unto mankind for three nights, though having no bodily defect."

19:11.text: Then he came out to his people from Al-Mihrâb
(a praying place or a private room)
, and he told them by signs to glorify Allâh’s Praises in the morning and in the afternoon.
